entry.title: CABIRI
entry.text: CABIRI, a term in the biology of the ancient Pagars, figuring great and powerful gods, being a name given to the gods of Samotbracia. They were allo worthipped in other parts of Greece, as Lemos and Thehees, where the cabinets were celebrated in honour of them; the fests go are laid to be, in number, four, viz. Axieros, Axiocerla, Axiocerfius, and Calinila.
